What to record: Identify room, cabinet, assembly ID, and released revision.
Record the person responsible and assembly date or shift.
List the parts and material group entering the operation.
State the face, edge, datum, drawing note, or tolerance used.
Example: Front edges flush / diagonals within 1 mm

What to record: Reconcile every required part, joint, handed component, and temporary spacer.
Record gap, flushness, insertion force, rocking, bow, and interference by joint.
Record diagonals, twist, opening sizes, moving clearance, and hardware trial.
Record rework, changed parts, new revision, approver, and release status.
